title: eupatorium ivifolium var. genuinum
intro: Eupatorium ivifolium var. genuinum, commonly known as White Snakeroot, is a plant species native to North America, belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and acting as an antispasmodic, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of White Snakeroot are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its ability to stimulate sweating and reduce body temperature.
